The '''Marina District''' was an urban area located within the central [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the second largest settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The district bordered the [[Government Education Center]] and the residential areas, while facing [[Lake Varum]].<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>
